brief:
Israel's Defence Minister announced the arrest of Gaza's internal security chief during a special military operation, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted a senior Palestinian security official responsible for internal affairs within the enclave.

The arrest marks a significant development in Israeli military activity in Gaza, though the Defence Ministry did not immediately release details about the identity of the detained official or the specific circumstances surrounding the operation. No statement was issued regarding the location where the arrest took place or the purpose behind the targeted operation.
title: Israeli defence minister announces arrest of Gaza security official in special operation
